newsitem.title: USA: Rainforest Cafe backs earnings estimates.
newsitem.headline: Rainforest Cafe backs earnings estimates.

text.p: Rainforest Cafe Inc Chief Financial Officer Mark Robinow said Wednesday he was comfortable with analysts' consensus estimates that the company will earn $0.15 a share for the second quarter and $0.78 for the full year.
Speaking at the Piper Jaffray investors conference here, Robinow said first-quarter results of $0.16 a share, excluding a $0.07 write-off, were $0.02 above expectations.
Robinow said first-quarter results reflected strong retail sales and favorable operating margins.
"We continue to improve our units' operations and contributions," he said.
